svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TMC5160A: UART chain of two nodes
svg.desc: Schematic of the TMC5160A uart chain of two nodes: the chip with U2 MCU, U3 TMC5160 node 2 (supply and ground as node 1), R1 resistor 1 kΩ, C1 capacitor 100 nF; the MCU wires carry the port hooks GpioGet(InputPin::Diag1), GpioSet(CtrlPin::DrvEnn), Transfer().
svg.text: TMC5160A: UART chain of two nodes
Two TMC5160 on one single wire line: the MCU's TX through a resistor and its RX meet on SWP, SWN stays open, and NAO of the first node drives NAI of the second so each can be
given its own address. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: 5.4 Addressing Multiple Nodes, p. 29.
TMC5160 node 2 (supply and ground as node 1)
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R1 1 kΩ: the series value is a choice; the datasheet shows the wiring only.
